summary: Frontend-only retest using the simulated electronAPI harness (open4) and a mocked TMDB. Added /app/tests/test_iter38_retest.py for the new checks. Results: (1) HIGH fix PASS. X:\TV\Modern Marvels holds S01E01..S01E05, 'S02E01 - Bridges' and 'Modern Marvels - Hoover Dam'. Scanned as TV and as Docs, it gives ONE group 'show|x:\tv\modern marvels' (7 files, whole show) and merges into 1 card with 7 parts. Only search/tv calls are made and no file is matched as a movie. run_movies_and_loose: Show.A/B/C stay apart (only the Show A two-part group), Movies\2019 A/B stay separate, DocFilms stay separate. (2) MEDIUM Add Files dropdown fix PASS. For TV and for Docs, the category menu shows 'All TV Shows | 1 | Breaking Bad | 1' (or 'All Documentaries | 1 | Breaking Bad | 1'), and the All filter shows the card. When a TV folder already exists, the badge reads 'TV Shows 2' and the menu lists TV 1 and Breaking Bad 1. For Movies, the badge reads 3 and matches the 3 filtered cards. Stats page counts are correct. (3) MEDIUM loose films fix PASS. X:\Kids (Toy Story, Cars, Shrek (2001), Up) as anim or docs: no group, and all 4 are auto-matched as movies (search/movie). Free Solo / Man on Wire / Senna / Jiro as docs: no group, matched as movies. Folders that look like a series do group: numbered docs (01 - Oceans..), folder-named docs (Planet Earth - X), and files sharing the first two words (Looney Tunes X, as anim). (4) LOW fixes: the Scan button reads 'Scan for Movies' for movies and 'Scan for Shows' for tv/docs/anim. The description now reads 'Select a folder and what it contains, then scan'. Escape resets the picker, but the footer Cancel button does NOT (see issues). (5) Regressions all match the earlier baseline with no page errors: iter37 (MM 600 files as docs, docs via parent, tv with auto off, anim: 1 card of 600 parts, 0 movie searches; add_files with the naming tip; add_files tv/docs/movies/existing tv dir; cancel resets; loose_films_no_years -> SEPARATE); iter36 (extras variants on and off 10/10, type_switch, type_switch_movies_dir, structures); iter35 (all 4); iter34 (run_suggest, run_scan, run_edges, run_stats_other_page, run_regress_tv_cat, run_dir_categories).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the Cancel button calls setIsOpen(false) directly and skips the Dialog onOpenChange handler that runs setImportType(null). After Cancel and reopen, the earlier pill (Animations) is still selected and Scan is enabled. Escape and the X button do reset. Fix: onClick={function() { setIsOpen(false); setImportType(null); }}.

ui_bugs.component: DirectoryDropdowns badge / 'All <type>' count with nested typed folders
ui_bugs.issue: Scanning M:\Movies\2019 as Movies while M:\Movies is already a Movies folder: the library has 3 cards, but the Movies badge and the 'All Movies' item show 5. The menu lists Movies 3 and 2019 2, and total = sum(dirCounts) counts files in nested folders twice. The badge does not match the filtered result. This likely existed before the typedDirs change but still breaks 'badge counts match the filter'. Fix: compute each category total by counting cards that fall under ANY dir of that category (dedupe per card), not by summing per-dir counts.

action_items: LOW: LocalDirectoryBrowser Cancel button: also call setImportType(null) (it bypasses onOpenChange).
MEDIUM: CategoryDropdown total: count unique cards under any dir of that category, so nested typed folders (M:\Movies + M:\Movies\2019) are not counted twice (badge 5 vs 3 cards).
critical_code_review_comments: looksLikeSeries 'same first two words' rule: with 4 loose documentary films, two titles starting 'The Story ...' or 'The Last ...' reach half (2 of 4) and the whole folder becomes one show. Consider skipping stop-words such as 'the' or 'a', or requiring more than half.

Loose SxxExx scan: before the merge, the TV search is also sent for the individual episode title ('Modern Marvels - Hoover Dam', 'Modern Marvels - Topic 0'). This is an extra TMDB call per folder; harmless, but there may be more calls on big folders.

Add Files as Movies saves the whole parent folder (D:\Downloads) as 'movies' in dir_categories. Later Downloads subfolders picked as TV then rely on the deepest-folder rule; a broad Movies root may hide future show grouping in Downloads.
Add Files as Movies sends search/movie twice per title, plus search/tv calls (Alien, Aliens). This duplicate auto-match work also appeared in iter36.

success_rate.frontend: ~95%: all 4 requested retests pass and all regressions pass; 1 LOW (Cancel button reset) and 1 MEDIUM (nested-folder badge double count) remain
